title: Poverty Targeting with Imperfect Information
abstract: arXiv:2506.18188v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: How should antipoverty programs allocate transfers when household income is known only through noisy predictions? I formulate this as a statistical decision problem in which a policymaker chooses nonnegative transfers within a fixed budget to minimize squared deviations of post-transfer income from the poverty line. I show that the standard plug-in rule, which treats predictions as exact, is inadmissible. I then develop a nonparametric empirical Bayes allocation rule that replaces the estimated gaps with posterior mean poverty gaps. Its Bayes regret is bounded by the mean squared difference between its posterior mean gaps and the oracle's, so the budget and nonnegativity constraints do not slow its convergence to the oracle. The approach extends, with weaker guarantees, to a planner who cares only about how far households remain below the poverty line after transfers and to programs that pay a fixed set of benefit amounts. translated_title: 不完全信息下的贫困瞄准
translated_abstract: 当家庭收入仅能通过含噪声的预测获知时，反贫困项目应如何分配转移支付？我将这一问题构建为一个统计决策问题：政策制定者在固定预算内选择非负的转移支付，以最小化转移后收入与贫困线之间偏差的平方。我证明，将预测视为精确值的标准代入规则是不容许的。随后，我提出了一种非参数经验贝叶斯分配规则，用后验平均贫困缺口替代估计的缺口。其贝叶斯遗憾由其后验平均缺口与神谕缺口之间的均方误差所界定，因此预算约束与非负性约束不会减缓其向神谕收敛的速度。该方法还可（以较弱的保证）扩展至仅关注转移后家庭仍低于贫困线程度的规划者，以及支付固定一组补助金额的项目。
tldr: 该论文提出一种非参数经验贝叶斯分配规则，用后验平均贫困缺口替代含噪预测的估计值来分配扶贫转移支付，并证明预算与非负约束不会减缓其向最优神谕规则收敛。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a nonparametric empirical Bayes allocation rule for antipoverty transfers that replaces noisy prediction-based gap estimates with posterior mean poverty gaps, and shows that budget and nonnegativity constraints do not slow its convergence to the oracle.
